facts.label: Dia das Mães
facts.sub: Nos EUA, o Dia das Mães é no segundo domingo de maio. Famílias fazem cartões, compram flores e preparam um café da manhã especial.

facts.label: Feito à mão
facts.sub: Cartões feitos à mão têm um valor especial. Use papel, giz de cera e uma frase curta e carinhosa, como Thank you for everything.

pages.title: A handmade card · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday evening in a warm living room in Denver. Leo and his sister Mia sit at the table with paper and crayons. Mother’s Day is only three days away. Their mom is out for a walk. They want to prepare a surprise. Mia takes a big white sheet from a drawer.
“Mia, Mother’s Day is on Sunday. What should we do?” says Leo. “We should make a card. Mom loves handmade things.” says Mia. “Good idea. What should we write?” says Leo.
